blurb: Thousand Islands Marina offers waterfront cottage rentals and marina services at Millens Bay on the St. Lawrence River between Cape Vincent and Clayton. They have 6 cottages available for nightly (2 night minimum) or weekly rentals and 2 suites available for weekly rentals. The marina provides seasonal and transient dockage, 24/7 marine gas, and boat launch.
